# Retained desktop updater public keys, append-only, one minisign public
# key per line. The first entry is the current key and MUST equal
# plugins.updater.pubkey in the desktop tauri.conf.json (asserted by
# publish-channel.test.mjs). Rotating the updater key means updating the
# Tauri config AND appending the retired key here, in the same reviewed
# change: historical archives are immutable and stay valid under the key
# that signed them, so channel validation verifies each archive against
# the key its signature names from this reviewed set — never against a
# key list carried in the public channel repository.
